correctness.rationale: Every idempotent is uniquely the ancestor projection onto its fixed set containing the root. The path criterion exactly characterizes commutation by comparing deepest fixed ancestors; the three inherited states encode that criterion, and a disjoint-subtree product count proves the recurrence. The chain and star specializations follow from the same recurrence.
